people.name: Mortar
people.line: A district or valley in or near Jerusalem

translations.web: Wail, you inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the people of Canaan are undone! All those who were loaded with silver are cut off.
translations.bsb: Wail, O dwellers of the Hollow, for all your merchants will be silenced; all who weigh out silver will be cut off.
translations.kjv: Howl, ye inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the merchant people are cut down; all they that bear silver are cut off.
translations.asv: Wail, ye inhabitants of Maktesh; for all the people of Canaan are undone; all they that were laden with silver are cut off.
